request: Backstabbing Thief: Sneaky and sinister, hides in shadows before he strikes. Never fights fair. He holds a dagger in his right hand and a bag at his neck; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Backstab: quick sidestep as if slipping behind the target, then a clean double stab forward and down (two stabs, 'hit' at the second), then hops back into his crouch.
